name: kit.file_add
description: A new brand file, under the client's id, titled from its name; it goes first. The same id again answers with the file it made; an id another brand holds is refused.
sql: with made as (insert into brandbase.brand_files as f (id, brand_id, title, kind, name, media_id, updated_at) values (:id, :brand, brandbase.plain_title(btrim(:name)), brandbase.file_kind(btrim(:name)), btrim(:name), :mediaId, :now::timestamptz) on conflict (id) do update set id = excluded.id where f.brand_id = excluded.brand_id returning f.*) select brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(m)) || jsonb_build_object('updatedAt', brandbase.iso(m.updated_at)) as result from made m
